title: TikTok Growth Monitor
description: Track a batch of TikTok profiles over time: follower and view growth, new videos, and viral outliers.

profiles.title: TikTok profiles
profiles.description: Profiles to monitor. Accepts bare handles (tiktok), @handles (@tiktok) or full profile URLs (https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktok). Duplicates are merged, so you are never charged twice for the same profile.

videosPerProfile.title: Videos per profile
videosPerProfile.description: How many of the most recent videos to fetch per profile. This is the window the median, outlier and per-video delta maths run over. Bigger windows give a more stable median but cost more at the base scraper.

outlierMultiplier.title: Viral outlier multiplier
outlierMultiplier.description: A video is flagged as a viral outlier when its view count is at least this many times the profile's median view count over the fetched window. 3 is a good default; lower it to 2 for a chattier alert feed.

snapshotStoreName.title: Snapshot store name
snapshotStoreName.description: Named key-value store that holds each profile's previous snapshot so growth deltas survive between runs. Keep the default unless you want two independent monitoring schedules that must not share history.
snapshotStoreName.sectionDescription: Sensible defaults — you only need these for multiple schedules, alerting, or if the base scraper is ever renamed.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: If set, the compact run summary is POSTed here as JSON when the run finishes. Point it at Slack, Make, n8n, Zapier or your own endpoint to get growth and viral-outlier alerts. Leave empty to skip.

baseActor.title: Base scraper Actor ID
baseActor.description: The Actor used to fetch the raw TikTok data. Defaults to Clockworks' TikTok Profile Scraper, the most-used TikTok scraper on the Store. Its run is started under YOUR account and billed to you at its own price, on top of this Actor's fee — see the Pricing section of the README. Only change this if the base Actor is renamed.
